name: python-dependency-resolver
title: Dependency resolution that explains every choice
blurb: Semantic versions, the four ranges people get wrong, and a backtracking search that keeps its dead ends: the highest version is tried first, a branch that makes a later requirement unsatisfiable is abandoned, and the failure message names the two ranges that could not meet instead of printing a best-effort tree. One version per package, lockfiles that hold still, and a check that fails only when the lock is actually wrong.
default_description: Resolve a dependency graph, explain each choice, and keep the lockfile honest.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
